pace: 18–20 mph on Violet Crown's page; the Strava club says 19–21 mph average over 50–60 miles
name: The Bagel Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am from Aug 15 (Violet Crown's ride page). The Strava club's Jan 3, 2026 event started at 8:30 am, so expect a later start in winter.
visitor_notes: Free and open to the public. The route is posted by Thursday. Click "I'm in" on the Strava event to get a push notice if it's cancelled; storms and the July 4 weekend have cancelled it this year. This is a drop ride, so know the route.
description: Austin's long-running Saturday road ride from north Austin, since 1992. It runs 50 to 60 miles at 18 to 20 mph and drops riders who can't hold the pace. The start is behind Little Woodrow's on Tech Ridge Boulevard.
evidence: Violet Crown's ride page lists The Bagel Ride for Saturdays at 7:30 am beginning Aug 15, from 12601 Tech Ridge Blvd, and the Bagel Ride Strava club shows posts dated Sept 5 and Aug 30, 2026 plus a weather post about the Oct 3 ride (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club page shows posts and an upcoming-event flag without a login; event details need one. Violet Crown's ride page carries the seasonal start time.

pace: 12–14 mph; Violet Crown labels it beginner
name: Women's Coffee Ride
schedule: First Sunday of every month, 8:00 am, from Mañana Coffee. About 2 hours at 12–14 mph.
visitor_notes: Free and open to the public. Violet Crown's page doesn't say which Mañana Coffee location; check the club's Strava or Instagram before the first Sunday.
description: Violet Crown's monthly women's road ride. It rolls from Mañana Coffee at 8:00 am on the first Sunday, runs about two hours at 12 to 14 mph, and the club rates it beginner.
evidence: Violet Crown's ride page lists the Women's Coffee Ride monthly on the first Sunday at 8:00 am from Mañana Coffee, beginner level, on a page whose other rides carry 2026 start dates (Jun 6, Aug 15); fetched Oct 1, 2026.

refresh.notes: The club posts events on Strava; the club page flags an upcoming event but needs a login for details.

season: BC season (spring to fall; mornings in summer)
name: Babes Ride (Breakfast Club)
schedule: First and third Wednesdays of the month, 6:00 pm in spring and fall (mornings in summer), from the BC Clubhouse. First Wednesday is Babes OG, beginner and no-drop at 12–14 mph. Third Wednesday is Babes Intermediate at 15–16+ mph, drop with regroups.
visitor_notes: Front and rear lights are required, plus a flat kit and a route on your phone. Rides end for food and drinks at Hold Out Brewing / Better Half; don't park there during the ride. The page says third Wednesday in one place and second Wednesday in another for the intermediate ride, so check the Strava event for the date.
description: Breakfast Club's ride for women, women-identifying and non-binary riders, twice a month from the clubhouse in Clarksville. The first Wednesday is the beginner ride where no one gets left behind. The third is a step up with more hills and a faster pace. Both end with food and drinks.
evidence: Breakfast Club's Babes page gives the schedule, 600 Harthan St start and 6:00 pm spring-and-fall time, and the club's home page promotes a 2026 collaboration kit; the page shows no ride dates (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The page says to check the Strava event for time and route updates; the club page needs a login to list events.

pace: A, B and C groups are drop rides with regroups; D group is an absolute no-drop road ride
name: Breakfast Club Monthly Ride
schedule: Once a month on a Saturday, roll out 8:00 am from Central Machine Works; arrive earlier for coffee. Dates are on the club's 2026 schedule page, which is an image.

start_location.name: Central Machine Works (enter on 5th Street)
start_location.address: 4824 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78702

visitor_notes: Free. The club suggests riding one group lower than you want your first time. Some months start from another venue, so check the schedule image or the Strava event first.
description: Breakfast Club's big monthly Saturday ride: hundreds of riders, coffee, a two-hour ride in A, B, C and D groups, then breakfast. D group never drops anyone. First-timers are welcome.
evidence: Breakfast Club's how-it-works page gives the Saturday 8:00 am roll out from Central Machine Works, and the schedule page carries a '2026 Schedule' image with nine venue entries; I couldn't read the dates (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The 2026 schedule is a PNG, so a robot can't read the dates; a person should read it.

name: Mellow Mondays
schedule: Every Monday, 6:00 pm. A 15–25 mile city ride at 14–16 mph.

start_location.name: Mellow Johnny's Bike Shop, downtown Austin

visitor_notes: Bring what you need to fix a flat, a helmet and lights. Routes vary. The shop posts route and ride updates on its Strava club. The shop's page lists two addresses (400 Nueces St in the header, 115 Sandra Muraida Way in the footer) and doesn't say which one the ride leaves from.
description: The shop's easy Monday evening ride: 15 to 25 miles around the city at a social, chill intermediate pace. The shop says no drop, good vibes.
evidence: Mellow Johnny's community page lists Mellow Mondays at 6 pm with a no-drop pace of 14–16 mph; the page carries no date, and the shop's Strava club flags an upcoming event (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

name: The Saturday Ride

start_location.name: Mellow Johnny's Bike Shop, downtown Austin

visitor_notes: The group may split but there will be a regroup. Riders handle their own mechanicals. Helmets are required. The shop's page lists two addresses (400 Nueces St and 115 Sandra Muraida Way) and doesn't say which one the ride leaves from.
description: The shop's Saturday road ride: 35 to 40 miles at an intermediate-plus 17 to 19 mph. The group may split, with a regroup. It sits between the shop's easy Monday ride and the faster club rides.
evidence: Mellow Johnny's community page lists The Saturday Ride at 8 am, 35–40 miles at 17–19 mph; the page carries no date, and the shop's Strava club flags an upcoming event (fetched Oct 1, 2026). The shop's older Saturday 9 am Scout-a-Route ride is no longer on this page.

pace: Four groups of varying speed; pick one you can hang with
name: Crank 'N Drank
schedule: Every Tuesday evening, wheels down 6:00 pm, on the South Austin trail network. About 15 miles, BYOB hangout after.

start_location.name: ATX Bikes (MTBATX's list says meet behind the shop)
start_location.address: 5701 W Slaughter Ln Ste A110, Austin, TX 78749

visitor_notes: This is a drop ride and riders must be self-sufficient. Bring a cooler, a chair and cash for Dominos, Tacodeli or TCBY after. Route info is at mtbatx.com. The shop's page doesn't give the meeting spot; MTBATX's list says behind the shop.
description: A South Austin Tuesday-night mountain bike tradition run by ATX Bikes. About 15 miles in four pace groups over everything from flowy singletrack to rock gardens. Drop ride. A cooler and chair hangout in the lot follows.
evidence: ATX Bikes' Rides & Events page (footer © 2026) describes Crank 'N Drank as a Tuesday evening tradition with wheels down at 6pm; the page shows no ride date (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The page also links the shop's Strava club for its road rides.

founded_note: The host's page says it started in Austin in 2011.
name: Queer Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday. Meet 7:00 pm at the south gate of the Texas State Capitol, wheels down 7:30 pm for a 10–15 mile ride.
visitor_notes: Bring lights (front and back), a lock and a helmet. Weekly ride details are posted on the host's channels. Some rides head out of town, so check the post for the week.
description: A weekly, inclusive, no-drop social ride for LGBTQIA+ folks and allies, started in Austin in 2011. Everyone meets at the south gate of the Capitol on Wednesday evening and rolls 10 to 15 miles together.
evidence: queerride.org says every Wednesday at 7pm from the south gates of the Texas State Capitol; Do512's weekly listing adds leave at 7:30 and a 10–15 mile ride. Neither page shows a dated ride (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Neither page carries dates; a local rider should confirm on the group's social channels.

name: Critical Mass Austin
schedule: Last Friday of every month, rain or shine. Meet 6:00–6:30 pm at the ping pong tables near Industry Bar, ride out about 7:00 pm.

start_location.name: Ping pong tables near Industry Bar

visitor_notes: A directory also lists a second Austin Critical Mass group that meets the same night at the Pfluger Pedestrian Bridge (wheels down 6:30 pm) and a Friday ride from Parque Zaragoza at 8 pm. This record follows criticalmassaustin.com, the site that says it is back.
description: Austin's monthly Critical Mass bike ride, on the last Friday of the month. Riders gather at the ping pong tables near Industry Bar on East 5th Street and roll out about 7:00 pm, rain or shine.
evidence: criticalmassaustin.com says Critical Mass is back, with a ride on the last Friday of every month, meet 6–6:30 and ride about 7pm; the page shows no dated ride (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

pace: Social; a different route each month
name: ATX Full Moon Cruise
schedule: Monthly, on the weekend night (Friday or Saturday) closest to the full moon. Meet 11:00 pm at the Pfluger Pedestrian Bridge, roll between 11:30 and 11:59 pm. Listed 2026 dates: Sat Oct 24, Sat Nov 21, Fri Dec 25 (11:30 pm). The annual September ride meets at 2:00 am.
visitor_notes: Unsupported and ride at your own risk. Don't arrive later than 11:30 pm. Bring lights, tools to fix a flat, water and a phone. The group tries not to drop slow riders but it can happen. If it rains they may gather under the circle instead. Details and reminders are in the group's Facebook group.
description: A monthly late-night social ride that leaves the Pfluger Pedestrian Bridge near midnight on the weekend night closest to the full moon, on a different route each month. There is also an annual ride in September at 2:00 am.
evidence: The group's dates page lists the 2026 schedule, with the next monthly ride on Sat Oct 24, 2026 at 11:30 pm and the annual cruise held Sept 26–27 (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The page lists every full-moon date for the year and flags which weekend night the ride takes.

founded_note: Started in October 2016, per the host.
name: Sunday Cruise ATX
schedule: Second Sunday of every month, 11:00 am to about 2:00 pm. The start park changes each month (Sept 13 started at the amphitheater at Girard Kinney Park).

start_location.name: Changes monthly; Sept 13 started at the Amphitheater at Girard Kinney Park

visitor_notes: Bikes and e-bikes only: no scooters, electric unicycles or hoverboards. The group often stops at pop-up markets, cafes, live music and art shows. The address given is September's start only; check the month's Eventbrite or Instagram post.
description: A relaxed social bike ride on the second Sunday of each month, going since 2016. The route is easy with few hills and stops at markets, cafes and free events. The club says it suits beginners.
evidence: The group's Eventbrite event for Sun Sept 13, 2026, 11 am–2 pm at Girard Kinney Park is linked from its Linktree, and its Strava club says second Sundays and flags an upcoming event (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The Linktree swaps in each month's Eventbrite event (the next ride is Sun Oct 11).

name: Monthly Group Ride
schedule: Fourth Saturday of the month, 9:00 am. The trailhead changes each month and is outside the city (Oct 24: Reveille Peak Ranch in Burnet; Sept 26 was Muleshoe Bend). Lunch after; RSVP by the Thursday before.

start_location.name: Rotates; Oct 24 is Reveille Peak Ranch

visitor_notes: RSVP by Thursday so the club can order lunch (vegan option available). Bring a chair and a drink for the hangout. Helmets are mandatory and the club asks for a mechanically sound bike.
description: Austin Ridge Riders' monthly no-drop mountain bike ride to a trailhead outside the city, from Dana Peak to Reimers Ranch and Reveille Peak. All skill levels, beginner to advanced, with lunch after.

name: Blur Thursday Nighter
schedule: Every Thursday, wheels down 6:30 pm from the shop. 27 miles at a tempo start of 18–20 mph with four race segments (4, 2.5, 1 and 0.5 miles), regroup after each.

pace: All levels, no-drop with leads and sweeps
name: STORM All-Level Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, meet about 6:00 pm, wheels down 6:30 pm at O.P. Schnabel Park (main pavilion by the play area). Dirt trails, 10+ miles, 2–3 hours. Rain or poor trail conditions cancel it.

start_location.address: O.P. Schnabel Park, San Antonio, TX

visitor_notes: This is not a paved trail ride: it's all dirt trails on a trail-worthy mountain bike. Bring a helmet, closed-toe shoes, water and lights if it will be dark before you finish. Free to join the ride; RSVP on Meetup.
description: STORM's weekly Thursday evening mountain bike ride on the OP Schnabel Park and Leon Creek Greenway dirt trails. All skill levels, no-drop, with leads and sweeps keeping everyone together. About 10 miles over 2 to 3 hours.
